tasks.label: Parameter table: check and regenerate
tasks.command: python3 scripts/dsp-kit/paramgen.py check parameters.csv && python3 scripts/dsp-kit/paramgen.py juce parameters.csv -o Source/Params.h && python3 scripts/dsp-kit/paramgen.py manual parameters.csv -o docs/parameters.md

windows.command: python scripts/dsp-kit/paramgen.py check parameters.csv; if ($?) { python scripts/dsp-kit/paramgen.py juce parameters.csv -o Source/Params.h; python scripts/dsp-kit/paramgen.py manual parameters.csv -o docs/parameters.md }

tasks.label: Harness: smoke
tasks.command: H=$(ls build/*Harness_artefacts/Release/*Harness | head -1) && python3 scripts/dsp-kit/dspkit.py smoke "$H"

windows.command: $v = Get-ChildItem build -Recurse -Directory -Filter *.vst3 | Where-Object { $_.FullName -match 'Release' } | Select-Object -First 1; Copy-Item $v.FullName 'C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\' -Recurse -Force; Write-Output "copied $($v.Name), rescan in Ableton Live"

tasks.label: Editor snapshots 100/150/200 %
tasks.command: T=$(cmake --build build --target help | grep -o '[A-Za-z]*GuiSnapshot' | head -1) && cmake --build build --target "$T" && S=$(ls build/*GuiSnapshot_artefacts/Release/*GuiSnapshot | head -1) && mkdir -p docs/ui && for s in 1 1.5 2; do "$S" --scale=$s --out=docs/ui/panel@${s}x.png; done

tasks.label: Shared code: refresh Source/oberli from the template
Validate: quick (pluginval)
tasks.command: V=$(ls -d build/*_artefacts/Release/VST3/*.vst3 | head -1) && python3 scripts/dsp-kit/validate_plugin.py --profile quick --plugin "$V"

tasks.label: Status: show Waiting for Björn
tasks.command: awk '/Waiting for Björn/{f=1} f&&/^## /&&!/Waiting/{exit} f' docs/status.md || echo 'no section yet'
